name: Iron Storm
look: a chunky white-armoured Lugia with a blocky visored helmet, glowing peach panels on its chest, thighs and massive cylinder wing-arms, peach-tipped spikes and thick legs on black clawed feet
entry: A Pokémon resembling Lugia, recorded in a report about a lighthouse that went dark when a machine flew out of a storm. The glowing panels on its armour store lightning for its wings.
how: Wild: very rare over oceans during thunderstorms.
